description: Synthetic: escrow ids, block hashes, block numbers and indexes are made up. Only the genesis hash is real (faucet GET /chain and tclk/flop/VERIFICATION.md). Page 0 for blocks 100 to 199 is a complete chain on its own (next_page null) with finalized opens for a1 and b2. Page 3 for the same blocks is not reachable from page 0, so the census ignores it, and it holds a finalized release for a1. An event on such a page is never evidence and is suspect: a1 is unverified, not claimed, with a note. b2 is funded.
